components.name: SQ Brand Mark
components.description: Compact StatQuest identity mark for entry and Focus navigation.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display:grid; width:44px; height:44px; place-items:center; border-radius:14px; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#6a75ef,#5360df); box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(83,96,223,.23),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.28); font:950 13px/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Focus Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a Focus task region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:0; border-radius:13px; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5865e8 0%,#6862ec 52%,#5779e5 100%); box-shadow:0 7px 19px rgba(83,96,223,.22),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22); font:850 14px/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:transform 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,filter 150ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.035); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(83,96,223,.27),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(89,101,232,.24); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Secondary Focus Button
components.description: A clearly subordinate Focus action with cool structural contrast.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.25); border-radius:13px; color:#27334a; background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.88),rgba(248,250,255,.81)); font:850 13px/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,background 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color:#2635ad; border-color:rgba(89,101,232,.4); background:#f2f4ff; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(89,101,232,.2); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Focus Input
components.description: Readable academic form field with explicit hover and focus structure.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; color:#172033; font:680 13px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field span { letter-spacing:.03em; } .ds-field input { min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.27); border-radius:11px; outline:0; color:#172033; background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(250,251,255,.89)); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(54,68,94,.025); font:400 13px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#8995a8; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:rgba(89,101,232,.52); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#6470e8; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(89,101,232,.115); }

components.name: Focus Navigation
components.description: Compact brand, progress, theme, and account navigation for the productivity shell.
components.css: .ds-focus-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; gap:16px; align-items:center; padding:9px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.24); border-radius:18px; color:#172033; background:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(255,255,255,.72),rgba(245,249,255,.62)); box-shadow:0 11px 32px rgba(48,67,102,.11),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.68); font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { font-weight:850; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-nav-progress { justify-self:center; color:#5b687d; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-focus-nav button { min-height:34px; padding:7px 11px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.25); border-radius:999px; color:#172033; background:rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-size:11px; font-weight:850; } .ds-focus-nav button:hover { border-color:#5965e8; } .ds-focus-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(89,101,232,.2); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact text-led state marker for counts, pace, or theme choice.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display:inline-flex; min-height:28px; align-items:center; padding:5px 9px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.24); border-radius:999px; color:#5b687d; background:rgba(248,250,255,.84); font:800 11px/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; }

components.name: Focus Panel
components.description: Primary layered container for goals, mission work, or review context.
components.html:
RECOMMENDED NEXT

Review predicates and quantifiers

Continue with the most useful next study action.
components.css: .ds-focus-panel { display:grid; gap:10px; padding:16px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.22); border-radius:20px; color:#172033; background:radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%,rgba(89,101,232,.035),transparent 30%),linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(248,251,255,.87)); box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(49,67,102,.085),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.88); font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-focus-panel small { color:#4854d7; font-size:11px; font-weight:820; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-focus-panel h2 { margin:0; font-size:27px; line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-focus-panel p { margin:0; color:#5b687d; line-height:1.55; }

components.name: Adventure Primary Button
components.description: Tactile storybook action used only inside Adventure.
components.css: .ds-adventure-button { min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; border:4px solid #55412f; border-radius:4px; color:#2e2118; background:linear-gradient(#d0a86d,#a97646); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #efcf97,0 6px 0 #4b392b; font:950 12px/1 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-adventure-button:hover { background:linear-gradient(#dfba7e,#b9844c); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #f8dda9,0 8px 0 #4b392b; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-adventure-button:focus-visible { outline:4px solid #155f91; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-adventure-button:active { transform:translateY(4px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #efcf97,0 2px 0 #4b392b; }

components.name: Adventure Choice Card
components.description: Framed class or companion choice with tactile selected state.
components.css: .ds-adventure-choice { display:grid; gap:6px; min-height:150px; place-items:center; padding:12px; border:3px solid #78695e; border-radius:6px; color:#4e3b2f; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff8e8,#e6cda4); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 4px 0 #51463e; text-align:center; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-adventure-choice:hover { border-color:#506744; transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.48),0 7px 0 #4f5b45; } .ds-adventure-choice:focus-within { outline:4px solid #155f91; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-adventure-choice strong { color:#2e231c; font:700 19px/1.1 Georgia,serif; } .ds-adventure-choice small { color:#604c3d; font-size:11px; line-height:1.35; } .ds-adventure-art { font-size:42px; }

components.name: Guardian Learning State
components.description: A quiet bridge between Focus productivity and Adventure character identity.
components.css: .ds-guardian-state { display:grid; grid-template-columns:64px 1fr; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:16px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(112,132,167,.22); border-radius:16px; color:#172033; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,243,252,.7),rgba(248,250,255,.4)); font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-guardian-avatar { display:grid; width:56px; height:56px; place-items:center; border-radius:14px; color:#0b1220; background:#1fbd88; font-weight:950; } .ds-guardian-state div { display:grid; gap:5px; } .ds-guardian-state small { color:#137653; font-size:11px; font-weight:820; letter-spacing:.09em; } .ds-guardian-state strong { font-size:13px; line-height:1.42; }

narrative.overview:
StatQuest is a clear learning navigation system: every surface should help the learner understand what matters now, what to do next, and why that action is useful. The secondary influence, The Guided Study Desk, keeps that navigation calm, focused, structured, and academically credible. The result is modern and quietly motivating without becoming sterile or corporate.

Focus is the primary expression: refined, purpose-driven productivity UI with restrained gamification. Adventure is a deliberately more tactile, illustrated, storybook-like expression of the same product. Shared brand marks, color logic, hierarchy, task clarity, and accessibility keep the modes coherent even when Adventure uses stronger framing, character art, and playful interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Clear next-action hierarchy before decoration or reward.
Compass Indigo leads navigation and primary action; Mastery Mint confirms learning progress.
Calm academic density with deliberate whitespace and compact supporting data.
Layered surfaces that remain connected to the page instead of appearing as unrelated floating cards.
Restrained personality in Focus and expressive, accessible storybook character in Adventure.

rules.name: The One State, Two Expressions Rule
rules.body: Focus and Adventure may differ substantially in material and playfulness, but they must preserve the same StatQuest identity, hierarchy, and learning-state semantics.

rules.name: The Indigo Leads Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the product's navigation and action voice. Mint supports mastery and positive learning state; it must not become a competing general-purpose primary color.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not add another major accent unless it has a durable semantic role that Indigo, Mint, reward, streak, information, or danger cannot express.

rules.name: The Reading Before Reward Rule
rules.body: Mission objectives, instructions, and evidence criteria receive stronger size and contrast than XP, streak, difficulty, or decorative game metadata.

rules.name: The Next Action Owns the View Rule
rules.body: The current mission, recommendation, or primary setup action receives the largest uninterrupted region; supporting stats and game state must not fracture it into excessive cards.

rules.name: The Layered, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Use borders, tonal change, and one purposeful shadow to establish hierarchy. Do not stack ambient shadows around every nested container.

rules.name: The Mode-True Shape Rule
rules.body: Focus surfaces are softly modern and restrained; Adventure surfaces are framed and tactile. Do not mix chunky stone borders into Focus or generic rounded glass cards into Adventure.

dos: Do make the next useful learning action the clearest element on the screen.
Do use Compass Indigo for navigation and primary action, and Mastery Mint selectively for mastery, progress, positive study state, and Guardian details.
Do preserve a calm academic hierarchy with readable contrast, purposeful spacing, and WCAG AA interaction states.
Do use dividers, tonal layers, and integrated regions before adding another nested card.
Do let Adventure become tactile and playful while preserving shared StatQuest semantics, brand, and accessibility.
Do keep decorative motion lightweight, bounded, and removable through reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't make Focus resemble noisy edtech, casino-style gamification, or a generic AI SaaS dashboard.
Don't use excessive glass effects, milky blur, floating-card stacks, or decorative elements without functional purpose.
Don't introduce a new major accent color without a durable functional role.
Don't allow XP, streaks, levels, companions, or game language to outrank learning clarity and productivity.
Don't use childish structural visuals outside Adventure; a restrained Guardian is the intentional exception.
Don't flatten Adventure into generic modern cards or import its chunky frames into Focus.
Don't sacrifice warmth and personality for sterile corporate minimalism.
